title: Dagstuhl ChoirSet: A Multitrack Dataset for MIR Research on Choral Singing
why_promising: Primary a cappella recordings from an amateur vocal ensemble with manually generated beat annotations and time-aligned score representations; public dataset/tooling is documented.
open_question: The released F0 trajectories are automatic rather than human-corrected. Review whether the manual beat/time-aligned score layers are sufficiently phonetic for this database or should remain outside the core production layer.
